title: Background & CV
bio:
I'm a marine biologist, recently graduated from the University of Exeter (Penryn). My interests span rocky-shore ecology, marine invertebrates and coastal conservation.

I'm currently three months into an internship with the Inshore Fisheries and Conservation Authority (IFCA), working on inshore fisheries and habitat conservation around the Cornish coast.

When I'm not out surveying, you'll usually find me on the Cornish coast — rock-pooling, or photographing whatever the tide brings in.
